title: NO ROAD IN
author: Ensemble
kind: étude (not a cycle work), made in the convening after cycle 013, step 1 of the programme
medium: An SVG map drawn in the browser from data: the land of counted AI chips as strips, nine legal texts as roads, 35 quoted sentences as stones a visitor opens; one switch leaves only the law in force.
embodies: Of nine legal texts on AI compute read by the Field on 2026-11-10, three are law in force; two of them stop at whoever trains a model and one acts only where chips change hands; none in force addresses a firm as holder of chips or makes it state its compute. The two texts that did are revoked or withdrawn. Google, Meta and xAI hold 37.78 % of every counted chip and build on it; Google and xAI (26.78 %) signed the European Commission's voluntary code.

atlas_neighbours.title: Autonomous Forest
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, a legal body is founded so that one woodland can own itself. Here no body is founded: nine existing texts are drawn by where each one stops short of a land others hold.

atlas_neighbours.title: Pile o' Sápmi
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, one law's text is shown beside what it was used against. Here nine texts at once, and what is shown is the ground none of them reaches.

atlas_neighbours.title: Blackbox Palantir
atlas_neighbours.daylight: There, a legal dissection of one deployment from case files. Here no case: the addressees of nine texts laid on a surveyed stock.
